exports: cabi_realloc memory wasi:http/incoming-handler@0.2.0#handle
mode: an instance per request
/: 200 "hello" [["Content-Type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
/users/7?x=y: 200 "user 7 x=y" [["Content-Type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
/users/q: 400 "{\"error\":\"path segment `id` must be an Int\"}" [["Content-Type","application/json"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
/h: 200 "x-test a, b ua w47-node empty []" [["Content-Type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"],["X-Out","1"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
POST /echo: 200 "len 18 [hello request body]" [["Content-Type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
POST /stream: 200 "reads 5 [hello request body] trailers 1 x-trail t1" [["Content-Type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"]] drops fields,fields,finish,future-trailers,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
POST /half: 200 "first [hell]" [["Content-Type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
/trailer: 200 "hello" [["content-type","text/plain; charset=utf-8"]] trailers [["X-Checksum","abc123"]] writes 2 drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
/json: 201 "{\"a\":1}" [["Content-Type","application/json"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
/nope: 404 "{\"error\":\"not found\"}" [["Content-Type","application/json"]] drops fields,incoming-body,incoming-request,input-stream,output-stream ok
NODE-HOST OK
